next_milestone.name: Pure fixture-only candidate-retention and nomination-disposition bundle contract
next_milestone.objective: Build and fixture-qualify deterministic canonical byte bundles for injected EP3 evaluation summaries, EP4 candidate payloads, and explicit append-only nomination dispositions without file, database, network, service or clock access.
candidate_requirements: exact EP4 candidate identity and input digest
population and all supporting reference identities
lifecycle retained as descriptive workflow state only
disposition_requirements: reviewer class without personal identity or credentials
candidate identity and exact ordered member operations
reason codes and supporting identity digest
reviewed-at logical sequence supplied by caller
false operator-identity, attribution, policy, ranking, integration, deployment and activation authority
replay_and_accounting: exact file set and canonical bytes
per-file hashes and one bundle digest
evaluation, candidate, disposition, group and membership counts
duplicate, conflict, missing and unsupported disposition accounting
fail_closed_conditions: schema, contract, engineering, provenance or authority drift
missing, duplicate, extra or altered evaluation/candidate/disposition
candidate identity or supporting-reference replay failure
review collision, sequence regression or altered reason codes
operator identity, ownership, attribution, score, ranking, policy, profitability or selection semantics
canonical, accounting, file-hash or bundle-digest mismatch

future_sequence: separate bounded EP3/EP4 candidate retention run if source evidence is authorized
PSI0F immutable-summary adapter application and operational-surface publication
next_action: Proceed autonomously with PSI0F-F9 safe-local fixture-only candidate-retention and nomination-disposition bundle contract implementation and qualification.
